_what: The Local layer for THIS deployment: which files are production entry points, and which core/ modules are known-standalone. Consumed by scripts/checkers/check_wiring.py through core/local.py. Values only -- rules that DERIVE (enumerate every seat runner, every hook dir) stay in code.

entry_points.why: THE door: every seat's hooks, runners, bus traffic and recall pass through it. Nothing else in this list is load-bearing for as many seats.
the MCP twin of the same door -- two doors, one verb table.
the bootstrap/install path a fresh machine starts from.
the shared config loader the doors read at startup.
the generic seat runner (the per-seat runners derive from it).
the Bifrost cockpit -- the surface a human watches the fleet on.
the wake watcher: mail arrives, a sleeping seat is re-invoked.
the runner's chat/tool loop; the runner imports it, so anything reachable only from here is still production.

W: the recovery ladder's own front door, on TWO paths -- the Discord !revive lever and the scheduled task that runs `--target gateway` as L1's supervisor. Added 2026-08-24 after the gate refused core/fleet/app_package.py as unwired when it was wired to exactly this door; the register was accurate and had stopped being about anything.

W156 (2026-08-14): a real CLI door -- argparse + __main__ -- run by a human to seed a twin's memory from a higher world. Added BY NAME deliberately: the general fix (enumerate every __main__ script) would change what this gate MEANS, and widening a gate is a gate decision, not a midnight one.
W160: a world's restore point (code + memory).
W163: what a checkout can and cannot do.
W164: verbs whose answer nobody outside can check.
W168: score fan lenses by what survived.

the 24/7 SUPERVISOR -- it spawns runners and owns wake. Added 2026-08-18: it was never an entry point, so core/comm/discord_feed.py (called from the daemon's own loop) reported built-not-wired while being precisely wired.

the out-of-tree DSH/cordis adapter, DEPLOYED to $DSH_HOME so no in-tree walk reaches it. Added 2026-08-24: core/comm/roster.py::go_offline (called only from here) reported built-not-wired while being precisely wired. This is also the line that keeps an out-of-tree seat VISIBLE to the gate that governs it.
